key_insight: MS-Exam-Gen is a reproducible, source-grounded pipeline for building and auditing a text-only multiple-choice benchmark to test LLM knowledge of multiple sclerosis MRI-related concepts, criteria, and reporting.
clinical_relevance: It can help compare how well biomedical LLMs handle evolving subspecialty knowledge, but it is for research evaluation rather than clinical diagnosis or direct image interpretation.
method: Indexed 66 expert sources into 4,289 retrieval chunks
Generated a locked 3,058-item candidate MCQ benchmark across 16 topics and 53 subtopics
Added automated quality audits, same-family consistency checks, and empirical calibration
evidence_signal: Across 12 LLM endpoints, the study produced 36,696 item-level predictions and found a wide accuracy spread from 89.7% to 46.9%.
watch_item: The benchmark is not clinically certified; construction labels are metadata, and expert adjudication plus full option-order counterbalancing are still needed.
paper_title: MS-Exam-Gen: Source-Grounded Benchmark Construction for Evaluating LLMs on Textual Multiple Sclerosis MRI Knowledge
